concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-transaction-create]] — manual Control Panel transaction creation, new-card versus Vault payment-method eligibility, authorization-only selection, and the industry-and-processor-qualified settlement-adjustment limit
warnings: Keep the Control Panel action distinct from the recommended API/SDK route.
Preserve the stored-in-Vault prerequisite for non-card payment types and do not present PayPal and Apple Pay as an exhaustive list.
Do not turn transaction creation or settlement submission into proof of final settlement or funding.
Keep settlement adjustment qualified by both industry and processor support, and treat the 2026-09-16 snapshot as collected rather than current support evidence.
